predecessors.name: Maya city-states (Preclassic and Classic)
predecessors.text: Yo'k'ib' (Piedras Negras) on the Usumacinta, Peten, Guatemala; the page gives no coordinates or area

ledger.x: About 460: the first dated king of the table, K'an Ahk II ('ca 460-ca 478'); the Yaxchilan page has King Moon Skull 'gaining a victory over Piedras Negras in 460'.

About 514: 'Piedras Negras may have established its authority over the middle Usumacinta drainage in about 9.4.0.0.0' (Panel 12 evidence); the Long Count date is converted to AD 514 by the researcher, matching Ruler C's capture of Yaxchilan's king in 514 on the Yaxchilan page.

808: 'Ruler 7's campaigns ended in 808 when he was captured by K'inich Tatb'u Skull III' of Yaxchilan; 'With his capture, the dynasty which had governed over Piedras Negras since AD 603 effectively ended' (the Yaxchilan page: 'ending dynastic rule there and destroying the city as a capital').

wars.name: Piedras Negras-Yaxchilan wars
wars.outcome: 727: 'the ruler was victorious over Yaxchilan ... capturing a sajal, as commemorated in Stela 8'; 808: Ruler 7 captured by Yaxchilan's K'inich Tatb'u Skull III and the dynasty effectively ended.

wars.name: Piedras Negras's wars on Palenque, Santa Elena and Pomona
wars.outcome: K'inich Yo'nal Ahk I 'defeated Palenque in AD 628, taking captive Ch'ok Balum'; 662 victory over Santa Elena (Stela 35); 725 'the capture of one of his sajal by Palenque'; 787 'the defeat of Santa Elena' and 'wars with Pomoná'.
